findings.text: The new placed-with-unknown arm in record_process_liveness changes record_process_alive's answer for a placed record whose scheduler cannot be queried from True (the pid fallback) to None, and the change was not propagated. Two existing tests assert the old contract and now fail at head: tests/test_crew_placed_liveness.py:74 (test_a_scheduler_reckon_cannot_query_falls_through_to_the_pid, 'assert None is True') and :111 (test_a_query_that_could_not_be_run_falls_through_to_the_pid). Measured by this review: the same file is 18 passed at the reviewed base c4425ab9 and 2 failed, 16 passed at head 2f471d42. The armed gate omitted this file, so the run's own suite pair records zero added failures while the repository suite gained two. The same answer reaches every record_process_alive caller, changing verdicts with no test for them, for example the widen claim at reckon/crew/claims.py:113 ('alive is True'), the resume refusal at reckon/crew/resumption.py:1288 and the promotion check at reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:345 ('is not True'). Either repair the owner's fallback so the old contract holds, or update tests/test_crew_placed_liveness.py and the documented record_process_alive contract in the same change; a node cannot land with two red tests.

record_process_alive's docstring still states that the job is asked first and 'the pid probe is the fallback for a record carrying no placement or a scheduler that cannot be queried' (reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:453-455). The new branch at :388 makes that false for a placed record: an unqueryable scheduler now yields LIVENESS_PLACED with alive None and never reaches the pid probe. The function every caller reads now documents the behaviour the change removed.

_record_is_placed (reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:221) restates the placement test that placement_job_alive performs inline at :256-257 (isinstance(placement, Mapping) and bool(placement)), so one fact is spelled twice in the same module and the two can drift. The predicate should be the single owner and placement_job_alive should read it.
